primary_claim: BiDPO-trained steering vectors, which previously boosted TruthfulQA scores by over 10% in Gemini 1.5v1 while retaining capabilities, did not outperform stronger prompt-based steering baselines after Gemini was updated to 1.5v2.

effect.value: >10% boost in Gemini 1.5v1; no longer beats baselines in 1.5v2

contradicts_or_qualifies: the authors' own earlier positive BiDPO result in Gemini 1.5v1, superseded once prompt-based steering baselines got stronger in 1.5v2
limitations_stated: it's hard to draw firm conclusions about BiDPO because TruthfulQA might not be measuring truthfulness/factuality
quote: BiDPO did not beat the stronger baselines, ending the project.
